name: io.github.iquest/ares-mcp
title: ARES (Czech business register)
description: Read-only access to ARES, the Czech register of economic entities. No credentials.

environmentVariables.name: ARES_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Total timeout per request in seconds (default 10)

environmentVariables.name: ARES_MAX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Most requests in flight at once (default 5)

environmentVariables.name: ARES_DEFAULT_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Page size when count is omitted (default 20)
